description: Search, move, mark, delete and draft your real mail over a self-hosted index.
name: io.github.alexanderkrauck/mailindex-mcp

environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection URL. This server keeps its own index and does not run without a database; the repository ships docker-compose files that start one for you.
environmentVariables.name: EMAILSERVER_DATABASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: How callers are authenticated: development (no auth, loopback only), single_user (static bearer token), or google (multi-user OAuth).
environmentVariables.name: EMAILSERVER_AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required in single_user mode. At least 32 characters, or the server refuses to start.
environmentVariables.name: EMAILSERVER_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Key used to encrypt stored mailbox credentials at rest. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32
environmentVariables.name: CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY

title: mailindex-mcp
